ingredients.raw: 2 to 3 tablespoons lemon or lime juice
½ to ¾ cup safflower oil
About ¼ cup extra-virgin olive oil
ingredients.item: about ¼ cup extra-virgin olive oil

ingredients.raw: Coarse salt and freshly ground white pepper to taste
ingredients.item: coarse salt and freshly ground white pepper to taste

ingredients.raw: 1 head bib lettuce, washed and spin-dried

steps.text: Whisk the egg yolk in a bowl until thick and sticky. Whisk in the mustard and lemon juice. A few drops at a time, add the safflower and olive oils (you may increase the amount as the emulsion forms).
When you have a thick mayonnaise add the tarragon and season with salt and pepper to taste. Toss the crab meat into this mixture and refrigerate until ready to serve.
Arrange the lettuce leaves on individual plates and spoon some of the crab meat in the middle. Decorate with avocado slices, baby tomatoes and tarragon leaves.

name: Crab Salad With Asparagus, Lemon And Parmesan
author: Amanda Hesser

ingredients.raw: ½ cup (2 ounces) loosely packed Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese, in long, thin shavings (best done with a good vegetable peeler)
ingredients.preparation: in long, thin shavings (best done with a good vegetable peeler)

steps.text: Bring a large skillet of salted water to a boil. Add the asparagus, and cook until just tender on the edges, but still firm in the middle, about 4 minutes. Drain, and rinse under very cold water until cool. Dry on tea towels. Cut in 3-inch lengths.

In a large serving bowl, combine the asparagus and crab meat. Sprinkle the lemon zest into the bowl. Season with salt and sprinkle with olive oil. Toss very gently to mix. Cover, and chill for a few hours, stirring once or twice. Taste, and adjust salt.
Meanwhile, juice 1 lemon and reserve. Just before serving, add the juice and toss once more. Spread the cheese shavings over salad, and serve.

name: Craig Claiborne’s Thai Beef Salad
author: Craig Claiborne
description: In 1986, Craig Claiborne wrote about “an exceptional sauce ‘borrowed’ from the cuisine of Thailand, where it is known as nam pla, and Vietnam, where it is known as nuoc mam.” This fish sauce is made with an essence of anchovies. Claiborne said one of its best uses was in the preparation of this salad.

ingredients.raw: ½ pound lean, tender beef, preferably fillet of beef
ingredients.preparation: tender beef, preferably fillet of beef

ingredients.raw: 2 tablespoons corn, peanut or vegetable oil
8 sprigs fresh coriander with stems and leaves
ingredients.item: fresh coriander with stems and leaves

ingredients.raw: ½ teaspoon dried hot red-pepper flakes
8 cups reasonably packed romaine lettuce leaves broken into fairly large, bite-size pieces
ingredients.item: reasonably packed romaine lettuce leaves broken into fairly large

ingredients.raw: 1 cup coarsely chopped, trimmed scallions, green part and all
ingredients.preparation: trimmed scallions, green part and all

ingredients.raw: 1 whole cucumber, about ½ pound, peeled and cut into thin rounds
ingredients.preparation: about ½ pound, peeled and cut into thin rounds

ingredients.raw: 2 medium-size tomatoes, about ¾ pound, cored and cut into small wedges
ingredients.preparation: about ¾ pound, cored and cut into small wedges

ingredients.raw: 1 medium-size red onion, about ½ pound, cut into thin rings
ingredients.preparation: about ½ pound, cut into thin rings

steps.text: Preheat a charcoal grill or preheat the oven broiler to high.
Rub the beef with the oil and set aside.
Combine the lime juice, fish sauce and garlic and set aside.
Cut off the stems of the fresh coriander. Set the tender leaves aside. Chop the stems finely and add them to the lime juice mixture. Add the hot red-pepper flakes.
Put the lettuce leaves, scallions, cucumber rounds, tomato wedges and red onions in a salad bowl.
Put the meat on the hot grill or under the broiler and grill or broil to the rare stage.

When the meat is cooked to the desired degree of doneness, place it while it is still hot on a board and slice it as thinly as possible. Add the hot meat to the salad bowl. Stir the sauce well and pour it over all. Toss to blend, and serve immediately.

name: Cream Of Sorrel Soup With Root Vegetables
author: Christopher Idone

ingredients.raw: 1 small celery root, peeled and cubed
2 cups sorrel leaves, washed, stems removed and cut into fine ribbons
ingredients.preparation: washed, stems removed and cut into fine ribbons

ingredients.raw: Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
ingredients.item: salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: In a large kettle, heat the stock to simmering over medium heat. Add the celery root and Jerusalem artichokes and cook until soft, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, melt two tablespoons of butter in a small skillet. Toss the sorrel in the butter just to coat. Remove from the heat and reserve.

Using a serrated knife, remove the crusts from the bread and cut into one-quarter-inch cubes. Melt the remaining butter in a small skillet over high heat and toss the cubes in the butter and toast until golden, about three minutes. Reserve.
With a slotted spoon, remove the vegetables from the stock and place them in the bowl of a food processor and puree until smooth. Return the puree to the stock and season with salt and pepper.
Bring the soup to a boil and stir in the cream. When the soup is steaming, add the sorrel and ladle into hot soup plates and sprinkle with the croutons and chervil.

name: Cream of Wild Mushroom Soup With Lentil Sprouts
author: Craig Claiborne

ingredients.raw: 3 cups cold fresh or canned chicken broth
ingredients.item: cold fresh or canned chicken broth

ingredients.raw: ¼ pound dried lentils, sprouted (see note)
2 tablespoons finely chopped parsley plus parsley for garnish
ingredients.item: finely chopped parsley plus parsley for garnish

steps.text: Pull off stems from shiitake mushrooms and set aside. Cut off stems of cultivated mushrooms and set aside.
Cut shiitake caps in half. Cut each half crosswise into very thin slices. There should be about 4 cups.

Heat 4 tablespoons of the butter in a kettle or casserole and add celery, carrot, leek, 2 tablespoons shallots, onion and the stems of the shiitake and cultivated mushrooms. Cook, stirring, about 5 minutes and sprinkle with flour. Cook, stirring, about 2 minutes and add chicken broth. Bring to the boil and add cream. Let simmer about 20 minutes, stirring often from the bottom.
Meanwhile, put the cultivated mushroom caps into the container of a food processor or electric blender and sprinkle with lemon juice. Blend thoroughly. There should be about 3 cups.

Heat 2 tablespoons butter in a skillet and add the remaining 2 tablespoons shallots. Cook briefly, stirring, and add the cultivated mushrooms. Add salt and pepper. Cook, stirring often, over high heat, until mushrooms give up their liquid. Cook, stirring often, until the liquid evaporates. Set aside.

Line a bowl with a sieve, preferably of the sort known in French kitchens as a chinois. Pour the mushroom and vegetable mixture into the sieve. Press to extract as much liquid as possible from the solids. Pour the soup into a clean kettle or casserole and add the cultivated mushroom mixture.

Heat the remaining 3 tablespoons butter in a skillet and add the thinly sliced shiitake mushroom pieces. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring often, about 4 minutes and add the sprouted lentils. Cook, tossing and stirring, about 1 minute or until lentils are thoroughly heated. Add the chopped parsley and stir to blend. The lentil mixture may be added to the simmering soup or it may be spooned onto the individual portions of hot soup just before serving. Garnish each serving with more chopped parsley.

ingredients.raw: 2 medium-size tart apples, peeled, cored and chopped
Salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.item: salt and freshly ground black pepper

ingredients.raw: ¼ cup sliced almonds, lightly toasted

steps.text: Melt butter in a large heavy saucepan, add onion and saute until golden. Add apples and continue to saute over medium heat until tender. Stir in garlic and saute a few minutes longer.
Add curry powder and continue cooking the mixture until the ingredients are well coated with the curry.
Stir in the lentils, add the chicken stock, bring to a simmer and cook partly covered until the lentils are very tender, about 45 minutes.
Puree the mixture in a food processor or a blender.
Return the soup to the saucepan and add the cream. Bring to a simmer, season to taste with salt and pepper and add lemon juice. Serve sprinkled with toasted almonds.

ingredients.raw: 6 ounces whole red pepper or 5 ounces chopped ready-cut red pepper (1 ¼ cups)
ingredients.item: whole red pepper or 5 ounces chopped ready-cut red pepper (1 ¼ cups)

steps.text: Shuck corn and scrape kernels from cobs. Coarsely chop half of the kernels in food processor; spoon into saucepan.
Combine milk with remaining kernels, and process to cream; stir into saucepan. Cook corn over low heat about 7 minutes, to blend well and cook through.
Wash and drain beans, add to corn and cook 1 minute.
Wash, trim and finely chop red pepper; wash, seed and mince half the jalapeno (more if desired).
Heat tortillas in toaster oven.
Mince garlic. Take the corn mixture off the heat, and add garlic, pepper, jalapeno and vinegar. Season with salt and pepper, and stir well.

ingredients.raw: Salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.item: salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps.text: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Put the eggplants in a roasting pan with ½ cup of the olive oil and the lemon juice. Season all over with salt and pepper. Cover tightly with foil and bake in the oven until completely collapsed, 1 to 2 hours.

Scrape the contents of the roasting pan into a blender. Add the cumin, garlic and sesame paste, and blend, adding the remaining ½ cup olive oil in a thin stream. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve at room temperature with roast leg of lamb or as a dip with crunchy bread and pickled chilies.

ingredients.raw: ¾ pound fresh mushrooms, about 4 cups

steps.text: Rinse mushrooms and pat dry.

Heat butter in a skillet and add mushrooms, lemon juice, salt, pepper and shallots. Stir and cook about 2 minutes and add cream. Sprinkle cayenne pepper on top. Cover closely and cook 5 minutes. Uncover and reduce the liquid briefly.
Prepare the toast.
As the toast bakes, slice the mushrooms thinly. There should be about three cups.
Heat the butter in a heavy saucepan and add the mushrooms. Cook, stirring, until the mushrooms give up their liquid. Continue cooking until this liquid evaporates.
Add the cream, salt and pepper, and cook about one minute longer.
Spread each slice of toast with one-half teaspoon anchovy paste. Spoon an equal portion of the mushrooms over the anchovy paste. Sprinkle with parsley and serve immediately.
Trim off ends of each cucumber and cut in half lengthwise. Scrape away and discard seeds. Cut each cucumber half into thin crosswise slices. There should be about 6 cups.
Put sour cream, heavy cream, vinegar, salt, pepper and dill in mixing bowl and blend thoroughly. Add cucumber slices and toss.

ingredients.raw: 3 teaspoons corn, safflower or olive oil
2 pounds domestic mushrooms, chopped in a food processor (about 3 cups)
ingredients.preparation: chopped in a food processor (about 3 cups)

steps.text: Bring a small pot of water to a boil. Add the scallion greens and boil for about 10 seconds, until the greens are softened. Drain, pat dry and set aside.

Heat two teaspoons of the oil in a nonstick skillet. When hot, add the onion and nuts and cook until the onion is softened and the nuts are browned. Add the mushroom duxelle and cook until the liquid evaporates, about three minutes. Toss in the chives and season with the Tabasco, sugar and salt.

In a small skillet, heat the remaining one teaspoon of oil. When hot, add the shiitake mushrooms and the water, cover the pan and cook about two minutes. Remove the cover and continue to cook until all the water has evaporated and the mushrooms are browned. Brush the tops of the shiitake mushrooms with the soy sauce and cut each into thirds.

To serve, arrange each crepe in a small cup and fill the center with a heaping tablespoon of the mushroom filling. Lift up all sides of each crepe and tie together at the top with a piece of scallion green. (The packets should resemble money sacks.) Put one sack on each plate and garnish the plates with pieces of the shiitake mushrooms. .

ingredients.raw: ½ cup pearl barley (free of husk)
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil, more for tossing
3 cups coarsely chopped watercress, trimmed, washed and dried

steps.text: Cook barley in enough boiling salted water to cover, until swollen and barely tender, about 20 minutes. Drain, rinse briefly in cool water, and set aside. If you like, you can toss barley with a tablespoon or so of olive oil, and refrigerate for several hours.
When ready to serve, toss cress with barley. Stir in olive oil and lemon juice, then add salt and pepper to taste. Adjust seasoning as necessary, and serve.

name: Crisp Kale Chips With Chile and Lime
author: Melissa Clark
description: Easy, addictive and loaded with bright flavors, this is your new favorite way to prepare kale. Buy more kale than you think you need; these go fast.

ingredients.raw: 20 cups kale from 1-2 bunches (torn into bite-size pieces, washed and thoroughly dried
ingredients.item: kale from 1-2 bunches (torn into bite-size pieces

ingredients.raw: ¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
Flaky sea salt, or to taste

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350 degrees. Make sure the kale is dry; if it is not, it will steam rather than crisp in the oven.

In a large bowl, toss kale pieces with olive oil and kosher salt; you may need to do this in 2 batches. Massage the oil onto each kale piece until the oil is evenly distributed and the kale glistens. Spread the kale out on 2 17-by-12-inch jellyroll pans (or do this in batches). Bake the kale chips until the leaves look crisp and crumble, about 12-16 minutes. If they are not ready, bake for another 2 to 4 minutes.
Remove from the oven and cool to room temperature. Sprinkle with the lime zest, sea salt and chile powder to taste.

name: Crispy Mushroom Sandwiches
author: Yewande Komolafe
description: Golden fried mushrooms taste like magic between soft, warm buns. Coating the mushrooms first in cornstarch ensures that the seltzer-aerated batter sticks to their surfaces while sizzling in oil. The still-warm mushrooms are then tossed in a quick marinade of hot sauce and honey laced with parsley and feathery dill. You may find it hard to resist a few nibbles of the meaty, crispy-crunchy mushrooms, so go ahead and snack. Build the rest into sandwiches with a sprinkle of hot sauce and slices of fresh tomato and onion. Enjoy this alongside a bright green salad for a delightful new addition to your picnic or dinner table.

ingredients.raw: ¼ cup hot sauce, plus more for serving
1 teaspoon kosher salt (such as Diamond Crystal)
½ teaspoon black pepper, plus more to taste
1 cup loosely packed fresh parsley leaves and tender stems, coarsely chopped
ingredients.item: loosely packed fresh parsley leaves and tender stems

ingredients.raw: 1 cup loosely packed fresh dill or tarragon or a combination, coarsely chopped
ingredients.item: loosely packed fresh dill or tarragon or a combination

ingredients.raw: 8 ounces oyster and maitake mushrooms (about 3 cups)
1 teaspoon kosher salt (such as Diamond Crystal)
1 (12-ounce) can plain seltzer or sparkling water
ingredients.item: (12-ounce) can plain seltzer or sparkling water

ingredients.raw: Safflower, grapeseed or canola oil, for frying (about 2 cups)
ingredients.preparation: grapeseed or canola oil, for frying (about 2 cups)

ingredients.raw: 1 small red onion, thinly sliced into rounds
1 medium green or firm red tomato, thinly sliced into rounds
ingredients.item: medium green or firm red tomato

ingredients.raw: 4 soft burger buns, such as potato or brioche, split
ingredients.preparation: such as potato or brioche, split

steps.text: Make the dressing: In a large bowl, combine the honey, hot sauce, ginger, mustard, lemon zest, soy sauce, salt and pepper. Whisk together until smooth. Add the parsley and tarragon and stir. You should have about 1 cup.

Prepare the mushrooms: Tear mushroom clumps apart into pieces so the bases are ½-inch wide. Spread them out on a large baking sheet. Set a wire rack or paper towels inside a second baking sheet for draining fried mushrooms later (or prepare the same pan later).
Place ½ cup cornstarch in a medium bowl and whisk in ½ teaspoon salt. Working in batches, add the mushrooms and toss to evenly coat. Spread the mushrooms out in a single layer on the baking sheet.
In another medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, remaining ½ cup cornstarch and ½ teaspoon salt.
Fill a large skillet with ¼ inch oil. Heat over medium-high until it reaches 350 degrees. A sprinkle of cornstarch should foam and sizzle when it lands in the oil.
Pop the seltzer open and pour into the flour mixture. Add the lemon juice and gently whisk just to combine but do not overmix; a few lumps in the batter are OK.

Working in batches to avoid overcrowding, dip the mushrooms one by one in the flour mixture and carefully place in the hot oil. Cook, flipping the pieces every 2 to 3 minutes to evenly brown, until the crust is golden brown, 8 to 10 minutes total. Transfer to the prepared wire rack or paper towels to drain and season with salt and pepper. Bring the oil back up to 350 degrees between batches.
Once all the mushrooms have been fried, add them to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.

To assemble: Warm the buns in a microwave or toaster oven. Place a mound of mushrooms on the bottom buns, along with any dressing that remains in the bowl. Top with slices of onion and tomato and sprinkle with additional hot sauce. Top with the romaine and top buns. Serve immediately.

name: Crostini With Eggplant And Pine Nut Purée
author: Regina Schrambling

steps.text: Heat broiler. Peel, and trim eggplant, and slice into rounds about ½ inch thick. Lightly brush both sides of each slice with oil, arrange on a sheet pan, and broil about 6 inches from heat until golden, 7 to 10 minutes. Turn, and brown the second side. Remove from broiler, and stack slices so they steam to finish cooking.

Toast pine nuts in a small skillet over low heat, shaking often, until golden. Cool. Using a large mortar and pestle, grind pine nuts with garlic and ½ teaspoon salt until smooth. Coarsely chop eggplant, add to mixture, and work into a somewhat rough purée with the pestle or in a food processor. Add a little lemon juice to sharpen the flavor. Taste for salt; add more if needed, and season with pepper. Stir in herbs. Spread on baguette slices or crackers, and garnish with a basil leaf.

name: Crown Roast Of Pork With Grain-Mustard Jus
author: R. W. Apple Jr.

ingredients.raw: 1 8- to 9-pound crown roast of pork (20 chops), prepared by a butcher from two center rib roasts and tied to form a circle
ingredients.item: 8- to 9-pound crown roast of pork (20 chops)
ingredients.preparation: prepared by a butcher from two center rib roasts and tied to form a circle

ingredients.raw: Salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.item: salt and freshly ground black pepper

ingredients.raw: 1 ½ pounds Italian hot sausage meat

steps.text: Place the roast, bone end up, in a large roasting pan. Season with salt and pepper, then set aside.
In a small skillet, melt the butter and add onion. Cook until onion is translucent, about 3 minutes. In a large mixing bowl, combine the meat, bread crumbs, parsley and cooked onion. Mix well.
Pack one-quarter of the sausage mixture around the base of the roast and the remaining into the center.

Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a small bowl, combine fennel seeds, orange zest, kosher salt, cracked pepper and garlic. Spread the fennel mixture around the top of stuffing inside the roast and over the interior of the chops. Cover the tip of each bone with foil, and cover the sausage at the base of the roast with a band of foil.

Roast for 2 ½ hours, or until the temperature taken in the center of a chop reads 150 degrees. (Once the crust browns, cover it with foil for remainder of baking time.) Remove from oven, and allow to rest for 10 minutes. Place on platter. Serve two chops per person, with stuffing and jus.

ingredients.raw: 2 medium celery roots, trimmed, peeled and cut into ¾-inch cubes
ingredients.preparation: trimmed, peeled and cut into ¾-inch cubes

ingredients.raw: 8 medium carrots, trimmed, peeled and cut into ½-inch lengths
ingredients.preparation: trimmed, peeled and cut into ½-inch lengths

ingredients.raw: 4 medium baking potatoes, peeled and cut into ¾-inch cubes
ingredients.preparation: peeled and cut into ¾-inch cubes

ingredients.raw: 1 teaspoon salt, plus more to taste

steps.text: To make the lamb, preheat oven to 425 degrees. Combine the cracked peppercorns, celery seed and salt and rub over the outside of the roast. Bake, using recipe for Basic Crown Roast of Lamb (see recipe).

To make the vegetables, toss the celery roots, carrots and potatoes with the olive oil, salt and pepper in a roasting pan. When the lamb has cooked for 15 minutes, place the roasting pan with vegetables in oven. Roast for 45 minutes, tossing the vegetables from time to time.

Remove roast and vegetables from oven. Let roast rest while keeping vegetables warm, then turn roast over, place on a platter and fill the cavity with the vegetables. Place into a serving dish any vegetables that don't fit. Serve immediately.

name: Crunchy Burmese Ginger Salad
author: Julia Moskin
description: Many Burmese dishes carry the scents and flavors of neighboring India and China. In this salad, the dried shrimp of Yunnan, the part of China that borders Myanmar, mingle with crisped shallots, tangy lime and crunchy roasted peanuts for wild contrast and crunch. Julia Moskin

ingredients.raw: 1 cup Japanese-style pickled ginger, rinsed, drained and sliced into fine shreds
ingredients.preparation: rinsed, drained and sliced into fine shreds

ingredients.raw: ½ cup roasted or fried soybeans (available at Asian markets)
ingredients.item: roasted or fried soybeans (available at asian markets)

ingredients.raw: ½ cup toasted pumpkin seeds (pepitas), or use additional soybeans
½ cup chopped roasted, unsalted peanuts
½ cup toasted white sesame seeds, or use additional peanuts
1 ripe tomato, preferably plum, seeded and sliced into thin wedges
ingredients.preparation: preferably plum, seeded and sliced into thin wedges

ingredients.raw: 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice, more to taste
2 tablespoons powdered dried shrimp, or 1 tablespoon fish sauce
2 tablespoons shallot oil (see recipe), more to taste

steps.text: In a large bowl, combine all the ingredients except the shallot oil and salt. Toss together with your hands. Add oil and salt, mix again, and taste. Adjust the seasonings with lime juice, fish sauce, salt, and oil.

ingredients.raw: 2 cups crustless country bread torn in small pieces
ingredients.item: crustless country bread torn in small pieces

ingredients.raw: 1 medium red onion, sliced thin 2 tablespoons finely minced
Hot red pepper flakes to taste
ingredients.item: hot red pepper flakes to taste

steps.text: Slice the squid into thin rings and coarsely chop the tentacles. Preheat an oven or toaster oven to 400 degrees. Bring two quarts of water to a boil.

When the water is boiling, add the juice of half a lemon and season it with a teaspoon of salt. Add the squid and stir and when the water returns to a boil, drain the squid and allow it to cool to room temperature.
Spread the bread on a baking sheet, place in the oven and bake until the bread has dried out and turned lightly golden.
Heat the oil in a heavy skillet, stir in the garlic, remove from the heat immediately, pour the oil and garlic over toasted bread, stirring well.

Place the squid in a serving bowl and toss with the remaining lemon juice. Fold in the tomatoes, onion, parsley and hot red pepper to taste. Just before serving, fold in the toasted bread along with any oil and garlic in the pan. Season to taste with salt and serve.
